digest.component_or_area: binding store recovery and retirement lifecycle
propositions: Incomplete retirement operations leave exact identity duplicated in both live and retired state; recovery must remove the redundant pair only when tombstone, forward, and reverse identities agree exactly.

Recovery must occur at the validated write-bearing boundary in reconcile.py after staleness validation but before the first remote issue fetch, and must perform zero writes in construction, preview, dry-run, and read-only operation modes.

Durable tombstone is the authoritative retirement intent; later automatic 200, clear_absent, or same-key confirm do not override it; only explicit unretire removes the tombstone and prevents completion.
Rich-text handler mutation through all_bindings() must be replaced with the narrow facade operation to eliminate production code paths that mutate bindings outside the repository.
Pre-observation repair boundary and invocation site must be documented in ADR 0099 with explicit guidance on unretire reversal, rollback, and prohibition on broad staging.
Repeat completion invocation is a no-op; any mismatch or corrupt state leaves recoverable evidence and safety-aborts without unrelated mutation.
